description: HVAC load calculator (Manual J-lite) — Screening heating and cooling load for a house from area_sqft: heating BTU/h with a per-surface breakdown (walls, ceiling, windows, doors, slab edge, infiltration, duct loss) and furnace output size; cooling sensible + latent BTU/h, sensible heat ratio, exact and suggested tons, sqft per ton; heat-pump fit note. Optional zone (IECC climate zone 1-8, default 4) or winter_f and summer_f design temps, insulation=poor|average|good, ceiling_ft (8), stories (1), window_pct of floor area (15), occupants, ducts=unconditioned|conditioned|none. Offline block load, not an ACCA Manual J report. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
